items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: I got on the bus and left with Paul "Hucklebuck" Williams.

ctx.x: Cause their bass player had quit or something. I don't know what it was. And somebody told them about me and they called me up. And I say "shit, yeah." I'm ready to go. I got on the bus and left with Paul "Hucklebuck" Williams. OK. Now everybody in Paul Williams band is--is--is--raw men. I met a little young dude--I don't know nothing, bout nothing. All I know, I'm on this bus, I'm working my way back up to New York. We're playing all through the South. And strangely enough, man, this man had a fine band, man.
